stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Summary and Interview must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Guide and Summary must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Summary and Interview must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Guide and Summary must not occupy consecutive positions." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Brief → Demo → Guide → Summary → Interview
- Brief → Demo → Interview → Guide → Summary
- Brief → Guide → Summary → Interview → Demo
- Brief → Interview → Demo → Guide → Summary
- Guide → Summary → Brief → Demo → Interview
- Guide → Summary → Brief → Interview → Demo
- Guide → Summary → Interview → Brief → Demo
